texto_en: Labour-force participation includes employment and active job search; the employment rate counts only those who have a job. Keeping both figures makes it possible to see the difference between participating and being employed.
Distinguish labour-force participation (50.2%) from employment (42.2%). The 27.3% figure for 2018 belongs to the same series, but a change between surveys does not by itself explain the cause.
Labour participation and employment are not synonyms.
